title: Custom eggless housewarming cakes for new Schofields and Marsden Park homes
summary:
New home in Schofields or Marsden Park? One cake question shouldn't need an asterisk.

Every cake at Num Nums is 100% eggless — not some cakes, every cake. Whoever comes to your griha pravesh, vegetarian, Jain, or avoiding egg for any reason, gets the same cake as everyone else. No separate slice, no explaining.

15 flavours, any design, 48 hours minimum notice — that's what fresh baking actually takes.

WhatsApp +61 425 697 725. Pickup from Riverstone Shopping Centre, free parking included.
keywords: worried a new home housewarming cake won't suit vegetarian or Jain guests
